description: Rijnbuurt-Oost (Plan Zuid, BAG 1934-35), Boterdiepstraat 4-70 and Eemsstraat: a flat 6.1 m brick front of three white-framed casement windows with toplights per upper storey (the top storey's lower), a pair of house doors at one party wall and a wide three-light window beside them, mirrored in pairs (the doors meet the next pair's doors), under a flat roof whose deep overhang (0.75 m, a white fascia over a boarded soffit) runs the whole row
